notes.value: Kia EV5 sold by Lucky Motor Corporation in two trims, both on lithium iron phosphate batteries. Air: 64.2 kWh, front motor 160 kW (215 hp) / 310 Nm, FWD, 0-100 km/h 8.5 s, WLTP 400 km (NEDC 490), 18-inch wheels, PKR 16,850,000. Earth: 88.1 kWh, front + rear motors 230 kW / 480 Nm, AWD, 0-100 km/h 6.1 s, WLTP 500 km (NEDC 620), 19-inch wheels, PKR 21,850,000. Both prices are a limited-time cut of Rs 1.65 million announced in September 2026 (from PKR 18,500,000 and 23,500,000), still listed by Kia on 2 November 2026. Headline battery, power, range and price are the Air's; rangeMax is the Earth's. Common: top speed 185 km/h, 4,615 x 1,875 x 1,715 mm, wheelbase 2,750 mm, 513 L boot (1,714 L seats down) plus a 67 L frunk, panoramic sunroof, six airbags, vehicle-to-load. Only the Earth gets the ADAS suite (smart cruise, lane keeping, blind-spot avoidance, surround view), head-up display and massaging power seats. DC about 102 kW on the Air (PakNEV, 10-80% about 36 min); AC on-board charger power is not printed on Kia's sheet. Real-world range 344 km (Air) / 435 km (Earth) and 16.1 kWh/100 km are PakNEV estimates. Warranty 4 years / 100,000 km (spec sheet; no separate battery term printed).
